rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, before 2011).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera as 'Agrocampus Ouest'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, deep pink edges. up to 45 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Source: Website Alterarosa. Participant in 2011 competition.
